versions.content: Reception SEv with higher priority Where IdsMEventDis- placementStrategy is IDSM_BUFFER_DISPLACEMENT_SEVERITY_BASED, when a new SEv is received and no suitable IdsMEventBuffers is found and the severity of the new SEv is higher than the severity of at least one SEv already in the buffer, IdsM shall replace the least severe SEv already in the buffer with the new SEv. Note: In case where multiple events in the IdsMEventBuffers have the same least severity, it is left to the implementer which SEv to discard. Example: Where the IdsMEventBuffers is 5 and all the buffers are full, when a new security event is reported, IdsM shall drop the least severe event amongst all the 6 events. Rationale: Dropping a security event is inevitable when all the IdsMEventBuffers are full. In this case, dropping the least severe event minimizes the values of the security information lost.
